quotes.quote: She died in my arms, saying, "I don't want to die."That is what death is like. It doesn't matter what uniforms the soldiers are wearing. It doesn't matter how good the weapons are. I thought if everyone could see what I saw, we would never have war anymore.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: If we had no hope - for a cure, for winning the lottery, for falling in love, for the end of war, for being free of abuse, or for having food, warmth, clothing, and shelter - we would have no reason to go on. What you hope for doesn't matter, but rather the essence of hope itself.
quotes.author: Bernie Siegel

quotes.quote: Quote words that affirmall men and women are yourbrothers and sisters.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

quotes.quote: The first casualty when war comes is truth.
quotes.author: Hiram Johnson

quotes.quote: There's nothing funny about war. Well, aside from this joke Orafoura told me: What did WWI say to WWII? I wish I could tell you the punch line, but the restaurant was so noisy that I didn't hear it. But I laughed anyway, because I'll bet it was pretty funny.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

quotes.quote: The war to preserve the privilege of mythmaking
quotes.author: Marvin Bell,  Mars Being Red

quotes.quote: The enduring attraction of war is this: Even with its destruction and carnage it can give us what we long for in life. It can give us purpose, meaning, a reason for living.
quotes.author: Chris Hedges,  War Is a Force That Gives Us Meaning

quotes.quote: Only happy people have nightmares, from overeating. For those who live a nightmare reality, sleep is a black hole, lost in time, like death.
quotes.author: Guy Sajer,  The Forgotten Soldier

quotes.quote: In great contests each party claims to act in accordance with the will of God. Both may be, and one must be wrong. God cannot be for, and against the same thing at the same time.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: The Chinese used gunpowder to make fireworks for celebrations, and the white man came along and said, Holy shit, we can use this to kill people. What better way to celebrate than that?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

quotes.quote: We are meant to be.' He pressed his lips to mine again; against myself, against my worry, I once again succumbed to the power of his kiss. 'I know that now. Our love is stronger than magic, stronger than the laws of all Feyland. It will survive this...whatever the future brings.' - Prince Kian, Silver Frost.
quotes.author: Kailin Gow,  Silver Frost

quotes.quote: Foreknowledge cannot be gotten from ghosts and spirits, cannot be had by analogy, cannot be found out by calculation. It must be obtained from people, people who know the conditions of the enemy.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu,  The Art of War

quotes.quote: Whenever we want to combat our enemies, first and foremost we must start by understanding them rather than exaggerating their motives.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: In the battle that is philosophy all the techniques of war, including looting and camouflage, are permissible.
quotes.author: Louis Althusser,  Philosophy and the Spontaneous Philosophy of the Scientists: And Other Essays

quotes.quote: Once war becomes a clash of absolutes, there is no breathing room for mercy. Absolute truth is blind truth.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra,  The Third Jesus: The Christ We Cannot Ignore

quotes.quote: It is said that God is always on the side of the big battalions.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: God, there must be a meaning. Fiercely he was certain that there must be a meaning.Surely, while we live we are not lost.Oh Janos, Janos my brother!Surely we are not lost--while we live.
quotes.author: John Hepworth

quotes.quote: If you had hope, maybe you could find a way to make things change,. Because if you thought about it, there were so many reasons to try.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Gregor and the Code of Claw

quotes.quote: For us lads of eighteen they ought to have been mediators and guides to the world of maturity, the world of work, of duty, of culture, of progress -- to the future.
quotes.author: Erich Maria Remarque,  All Quiet on the Western Front

quotes.quote: Just above our terror, the stars painted this storyin perfect silver calligraphy. And our souls, too oftenabused by ignorance, covered our eyes with mercy.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  I Made My Boy Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: War is the greatest evil Satan has invented to corrupt our hearts and souls. We should honor our soldiers, but we should never honor war.
quotes.author: Dean Hughes,  Far From Home

quotes.quote: The warrior learns of the spiritual realm by dwelling on the cutting edge of the sword, standing at the edge of the fire pit, venturing right up to the edge of starvation if necessary. Vibrant and intense living is the warrior's form of worship.
quotes.author: Stephen K. Hayes

quotes.quote: The real power in America is held by a fast-emerging new Oligarchy of pimps and preachers who see no need for Democracy or fairness or even trees, except maybe the ones in their own yards, and they don't mind admitting it. They worship money and power and death. Their ideal solution to all the nation's problems would be another 100 Year War.
quotes.author: Hunter S. Thompson,  Kingdom of Fear: Loathsome Secrets of a Star-Crossed Child in the Final Days of the American Century

quotes.quote: [W]hat makes patriotic and religious fanatics such dangerous opponents is not the deaths of the fanatics themselves, but their willingness to accept the deaths of a fraction of their number in order to annihilate or crush their infidel enemy.
quotes.author: Jared Diamond,  Guns, Germs, and Steel: The Fates of Human Societies

quotes.quote: These men are worth your tears. You are not worth their merriment.
quotes.author: Wilfred Owen,  The Poems Of Wilfred Owen

quotes.quote: A brick could be used to perpetually feed the hungry, stop all wars, educate the masses, and ensure everlasting peace for all populations throughout time. Wait, I'm sorry, that's not right. I was confusing a brick with a blanket. It's a blanket that could be used for all those things.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  A brick and a blanket walk into a bar

quotes.quote: The idea of authority, which they represented, was associated in our minds with a greater insight and a more humane wisdom.
quotes.author: Erich Maria Remarque,  All Quiet on the Western Front

quotes.quote: In seven days God had created the Earth. In a single day mankind had turned it upside down.
quotes.author: Kristina McMorris,  Bridge of Scarlet Leaves

quotes.quote: This world's anguish is no different from the love we insist on holding back.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

quotes.quote: Suicidal glory is the luxury of the irresponsible.
quotes.author: Lois McMaster Bujold,  Barrayar

quotes.quote: Be a craftsman in speech that thou mayest be strong, for the strength of one is the tongue, and speech is mightier than all fighting.
quotes.author: Ptahhotep

quotes.quote: If my God damns people for love but saves them for brutle warfare, then that is not the God I know or wish to worship.
quotes.author: Cristina Marrero

quotes.quote: To say that the first casualty of war is truth is to miss the rather more important point that a principal weapon of war is lies.
quotes.author: Harry M. Collins,  The Golem at Large: What You Should Know about Technology

quotes.quote: APPLY WITHINYou once told meYou wanted to findYourself in the world -And I told you toFirst apply within,To discover the worldwithin you.You once told meYou wanted to saveThe world from all its wars -And I told you toFirst save yourselfFrom the world,And all the warsYou put yourselfThrough.APPLY WITHIN by Suzy Kassem
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: Peace is not so much a political mandate as it is a shared state of consciousness that remains elevated and intact only to the degree that those who value it volunteer their existence as living examples of the same... Peace ends with the unraveling of individual hope and the emergence of the will to worship violence as a healer of private and social dis-ease.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  The American Poet Who Went Home Again

quotes.quote: To live is - to war with trolls In the holds of the heart and mind
quotes.author: Henrik Ibsen

quotes.quote: Women particularly should concern themselves with peace because men by nature are more foolhardy and headstrong, and their overwhelming desire to avenge themselves prevents them from foreseeing the resulting dangers and terrors of war. But woman by nature is more gentle and circumspect. Therefore, if she has sufficient will and wisdom she can provide the best possible means to pacify man.
quotes.author: Christine de Pizan,  The Treasure of the City of Ladies

quotes.quote: Peaceful disputes are maintained when men sincerely believe that they are morally, logically correct about the issues at hand. It is when neither side is really certain that wars are instigated.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Much blood has been spilled over words, and a great deal of it over the word 'God.' (125)
quotes.author: Jean-Yves Leloup,  Compassion and Meditation: The Spiritual Dynamic between Buddhism and Christianity

quotes.quote: Beneath the violet pillar, in the vacuum before the roar of the cloud, there came a soft sound that might have been heard by those who listened closely: the gentle sigh of an idea unbound.
quotes.author: Lydia Millet,  Oh Pure and Radiant Heart

quotes.quote: Were prayers of murderers, when fighting on the 'right side' of the war, ever heard--let alone answered?
quotes.author: Kristina McMorris,  Letters From Home

quotes.quote: You can be sure of succeeding in your attacks if you only attack places which are undefended.You can ensure the safety of your defense if you only hold positions that cannot be attacked.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu,  The Art of War

quotes.quote: War is thus divine in itself, since it is a law of the world. War is divine through its consequences of a supernatural nature which are as much general as particular. War is divine in the mysterious glory that surrounds it and in the no less inexplicable attraction that draws us to it. War is divine by the manner in which it breaks out.
quotes.author: Joseph de Maistre

quotes.quote: There are no atheists in the foxhole.
quotes.author: Ernie Pyle

quotes.quote: Men die in battle; women die in childbirth.
quotes.author: Philippa Gregory,  The Red Queen

quotes.quote: A leader should always be open to criticism, not silencing dissent. Any leader who does not tolerate criticism from the public is afraid of their dirty hands to be revealed under heavy light. And such a leader is dangerous, because they only feel secure in the darkness. Only a leader who is free from corruption welcomes scrutiny; for scrutiny allows a good leader to be an even greater leader.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: Love' is the only weapon I have, I will defend with love, I will attack with love.
quotes.author: Amit Kalantri

quotes.quote: How many fears came between us?Earthquakes, diseases, wars where hellrained smoldering pus from skies made of winged death.Horror tore this world asunder.While inside the bleeding smokeand beyond the shredded weeping fleshwe memorized tales of infinite good.--from The History Lesson
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

quotes.quote: The line between him and the enemy had simultaneously blurred and solidified. Somehow, while perhaps it shouldn't have, this thought provided a strange sense of peace.
quotes.author: Kristina McMorris,  Bridge of Scarlet Leaves

quotes.quote: Hey, I am thinking of it myself, in this part of world (East), we all do endeavors in praying and are sweating (white liquid) and this is our situation, frustrated , but on the other part of world (West) ,they are enjoying in party and drinking liquor (white liquid) but their situation is that, successful, I do not know that the problem relates to the type of liquid or the way of drinking!!
quotes.author: Ali Shariati

quotes.quote: It's like we have the bones of animals and the hearts of angels.
quotes.author: Baxter Clare Trautman,  The River Within

quotes.quote: Smoke veils the air like souls in drifting suspension, declining the war's insistence everyone move on.
quotes.author: Jayne Anne Phillips,  Lark & Termite

quotes.quote: I let all that anger and worry go because they don't belong to me any more than the future does. And I don't wanna feel them anyhow, because the truth is, whatever happens when this war ends, here and now, far from Richmond County, I'm freer than I've ever been.
quotes.author: Teresa R. Funke,  Dancing in Combat Boots

quotes.quote: I spent half my childhood trying to be like my dad. True for most boys, I think. It turns with adolescence. The last thing I wanted was to be like my dad. It took becoming a man to realize how lucky I'd been. It took a few hard knocks in life to make me realize the only thing my dad had ever wanted or worked for was to give me a chance at being better than him.
quotes.author: Tucker Elliot,  The Rainy Season

quotes.quote: Smartass Disciple: Master, you should teach people not to do war to each other.Master of Stupidity: I should teach people how to win their minds of their wars.
quotes.author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

quotes.quote: The most important thing I gained from my travels was the knowledge that one could achieve anything with determination and an ounce of luck.
quotes.author: Stefan Waydenfeld

quotes.quote: The world is a different place in this new century, [...]. And we are a different people. My visions still come but no one listens any longer to what they tell us, what they warn us. I knew even as a young woman that destruction bred on the horizon. [...] War touches everyone, and windigos spring from the earth.
quotes.author: Joseph Boyden

quotes.quote: Some people have a heart to do evil and they don't care if you're Muslim or Christian.
quotes.author: Tucker Elliot,  The Rainy Season

quotes.quote: We often participate in a war only to lose our hearts and to gain a few pieces of land.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: When every heart is filled with peace and every mind is searching for peace, how can there be war?
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: The war for peace can destroy the whole world.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Create your own path.Don't blindly follow the massess... because most of the time the "M"is silent.
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quotes.quote: Your friends can be double-edged knife thy can either nurture you or destroy you. Choose them Wisely......
quotes.author: Abhishek Shukla,  The Reflection "Success or Stress"Choose Wisely

quotes.quote: I started to make a study of the art of war and revolution and, whilst abroad, underwent a course in military training. If there was to be guerrilla warfare, I wanted to be able to stand and fight with my people and to share the hazards of war with them.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela
